title: TMF (10 Mods a Fortnight)
description: 10 Mods a Fortnight (TMF) is a modpack I have made with friends where they vote to either add or remove mods every fortnight.
body:
Every fortnight the mods list is updaed (adding heavy/game changing mods on the 1st and lighter mods on the 15th) which is voted for by my friends.


As of now the experience is a fairly Vanilla + 1.21.1 experience with origins added. Right now there is a fair amount of farming mods such as Let's Do mods and Farmers Delight. There is also quests in the works with most of the Vanilla aspects of the quests hopefully available by Week 10. The modpack has been optimised to run on lower end PC's and should run well as long as distant horizons is disabled and has roughly around 50+ performance mods including Sodium, Lithium, Indium, etc.
